methodology_intro: Every candidate is sourced from ValuePickr threads active in the last 30 days (across Stock Opportunities, Stock Analysis & Valuation, and Stock Screening categories), scored on fundamentals (ROCE/ROE, real revenue/profit growth, manageable debt), technicals (weekly/monthly MACD + Bollinger Bands, or RSI/CCI/Williams %R as a documented proxy when BB isn't available), red-flag screening, and ValuePickr community conviction (including whether a high-reputation contributor made a specific high-conviction call) as a qualitative signal, never the sole basis.
scoring_dimensions: Fundamental momentum: the RECENT-QUARTER trend and any specific catalyst, not just the trailing 3-5yr average - a trailing average is structurally blind to an inflection in progress by definition, since it's diluted by the pre-inflection period. A stock with a weak 3yr average ROE but a real, catalyst-linked recent-quarter improvement is NOT automatically screened out on the average alone (see 2026-08-22 methodology fix note below)
Thesis fit: plausible path to 10x in 2-3 years OR 100x in 10 years - no market-cap ceiling, but the larger the company, the higher the bar for this claim
Catalyst clarity (specific, verifiable near-term triggers vs vague optimism)
Quality/governance screen (promoter holding trend, red flags, regulatory issues)
Technical posture (weekly/monthly MACD + Bollinger Bands, or RSI/CCI/Williams %R proxy)
ValuePickr community conviction, including verified high-conviction calls from top-reputation contributors (see top-contributors.md) - weighted as a qualitative signal, not a hard input
